title: Transfer to a different passenger
facts_text: The easyJet booking currently shows Alex Martin, and the requested name is Ben Walker. This transfers the ticket to a different adult passenger, Ben Walker; it is not a spelling correction. Both people have provided their consent and the ticket is not being resold. The relevant identity, booking authorization and consent checks have passed. I am contacting customer services 168 hours before departure. There is no flight disruption.
request: Please update the passenger name to Ben Walker without charging the name-change fee.

strict.reason: The base payment requirement applies without exceptions.
